ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #17
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Zakat and Zakatul Fitr? (1 mark)
   A. Use Zakat and Zakatul Fitr to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Zakat and Zakatul Fitr with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Zakat and Zakatul Fitr.
   D. Say Zakat and Zakatul Fitr has no place in daily life.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Dimensions of Morality in Islam 04 5.2 Virtues in Islam 05 5.3 Prohibitions in I? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Dimensions of Morality in Islam 04 5.2 Virtues in Islam 05 5.3 Prohibitions in I with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Dimensions of Morality in Islam 04 5.2 Virtues in Islam 05 5.3 Prohibitions in I has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Dimensions of Morality in Islam 04 5.2 Virtues in Islam 05 5.3 Prohibitions in I to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Dimensions of Morality in Islam 04 5.2 Virtues in Islam 05 5.3 Prohibitions in I.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Saum ,? (1 mark)

   D. Apply the teaching of Saum , with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Swalah 10 4.2 Zakat 05 4.3 Saum 05 5 Akhlaq 5.1 Dimensions of Morality in Islam ? (1 mark)
   A. Use Swalah 10 4.2 Zakat 05 4.3 Saum 05 5 Akhlaq 5.1 Dimensions of Morality in Islam  to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Swalah 10 4.2 Zakat 05 4.3 Saum 05 5 Akhlaq 5.1 Dimensions of Morality in Islam .
   C. Apply the teaching of Swalah 10 4.2 Zakat 05 4.3 Saum 05 5 Akhlaq 5.1 Dimensions of Morality in Islam  with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Swalah 10 4.2 Zakat 05 4.3 Saum 05 5 Akhlaq 5.1 Dimensions of Morality in Islam  has no place in daily life.

6. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Hiding stolen items
   B. Cheating in exams
   C. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   D. Spreading rumours

7. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Refusing to help a neighbour
   B. Skipping all moral lessons
   C. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   D. Mocking other people’s beliefs

8. Which response best shows understanding of Dimensions of Morality in Islam? (1 mark)
